name: clawd
description: Lets Claude chat dress up and animate Clawd, the pixel mascot on your desktop.
long_description: Clawd is a small desktop pet. With this extension, Claude can give him an outfit that matches what your conversation is about (talk about a DofE expedition and he gets a backpack) and make him react. Needs the Clawd desktop app running on this computer; it only talks to it over localhost.

tools.name: clawd_set_topic
tools.description: Dress Clawd in an accessory that matches the conversation topic.

tools.name: clawd_react
tools.description: Make Clawd do a short reaction (happy, celebrate, confused...).
